loop-review.description: Inspect a scoped change or repository and report prioritized findings with source evidence. Use for review; use loop-plan for planning, loop-evaluate for fixed-rubric scoring and loop-research workflows for adoption decisions.

loop-code.description: Implement an authorized feature or configuration change in small verified batches. Prefer loop-debug when the main goal is repairing a reproducible bug and loop-refactor when the goal is restructuring without changing behavior.

loop-diagnose.description: Investigate an unexplained symptom using competing hypotheses and discriminating experiments. Use for diagnosis without an assumed repair; prefer loop-debug for a requested fix, loop-diagnose-repro for minimization and the focused performance/regression routes when those are the goal.

loop-diagnose-repro.description: Run a bounded reproduction loop for a bug or failure: capture the environment, minimize the reproducer, vary one factor at a time, and preserve exact evidence for a later fix.

loop-diagnose-performance.description: Run a bounded performance-diagnosis loop for slow, memory-heavy, or resource-intensive behavior. Establish a baseline, profile safely, isolate a bottleneck, and verify a targeted improvement.

loop-diagnose-regression.description: Run a bounded regression-diagnosis loop: compare a known-good and failing state, bisect or narrow the change set, reproduce the regression, and verify the smallest authorized fix.

loop-research.description: Research a scoped everyday or technical question using primary sources, explicit criteria and a dated source ledger. Use to discover evidence or compare alternatives; use loop-summarize for supplied-source compression without new research.

loop-research-repo.description: Research repositories and open-source projects in a bounded evidence loop. Compare relevance, activity, license, security, compatibility, and maintenance before recommending adoption.

loop-research-tools.description: Research tools, extensions, plugins, skills, and MCP servers in a bounded evidence loop. Evaluate capability, permissions, maintenance, compatibility, cost, and adoption risk before recommending or installing anything.

loop-test.description: Select and execute a risk-based test strategy for a project or change when the required test layer is not yet known. Use focused unit, integration, E2E, coverage, adversarial or compatibility skills when that layer is already the main request.

loop-test-unit.description: Run a bounded unit-test loop for a module or function: select focused tests, reproduce failures, improve authorized tests or fixtures, and verify isolated behavior without weakening acceptance criteria.

loop-test-integration.description: Run a bounded integration-test loop across services, processes, files, databases, or external boundaries. Verify setup, contracts, failure paths, cleanup, and reproducibility.

loop-test-coverage.description: Run a bounded test-coverage loop: identify untested risk, inspect coverage evidence, add authorized focused tests, and verify that coverage improvements are meaningful rather than cosmetic.

loop-docs.description: Run a bounded documentation loop: audit README, guides, API references, examples, localization, and generated documentation; propose or make authorized updates; verify links and consistency. Use when the user asks to improve docs repeatedly.

loop-skill-create.description: Create or maintain an agent skill through requirements, reusable-pattern inspection, synchronized editing, focused tests, documentation, and evidence review. Use when adding or changing a SKILL.md workflow.

loop-orchestrate.description: Run bounded follow-up prompts through a configured headless coding-agent command with state, timeout, stop markers, and evidence. Use when a loop must continue in a new agent invocation.

loop-prompt.description: Run an initial user prompt, have the agent infer the next useful prompt, and execute a bounded number of follow-up prompts with evidence. Use when the user requests /loop-prompt N.

loop-debug.description: Repair a reproducible bug end to end: capture a failing test, isolate the cause, apply the smallest authorized fix, and rerun regression checks. Use when the user wants a bug fixed, rather than diagnosis alone.

loop-security.description: Review authorized code and configuration for security risks using threat boundaries, source evidence and safe local tests. Use for a defensive security review or scoped remediation, not unrestricted probing.

loop-refactor.description: Improve a scoped code structure while preserving observable behavior through characterization tests, small reversible changes and regression checks. Use for maintainability work without a feature or bug-fix behavior change.

loop-ci.description: Diagnose and repair scoped CI failures by tracing a failed job to logs, reproducing locally where possible, and verifying workflow changes. Use for CI pipelines rather than general application debugging.

loop-release.description: Prepare and verify a scoped release candidate: version consistency, reproducible build, package contents, changelog and rollback notes. Use for release readiness; publishing remains a separately authorized action.

loop-plan.description: Turn a scoped request into dependency-ordered, verifiable implementation batches without changing code. Use before multi-step work when acceptance criteria, risks or sequencing need definition.

loop-dependencies.description: Assess and perform an authorized dependency change with manifest/lockfile consistency, compatibility checks and rollback evidence. Use for project dependency maintenance rather than tool adoption.

loop-migrate.description: Prepare and verify a scoped data, schema or configuration migration with dry-run, backup, invariants, idempotence and rollback. Use when stored state or format changes, not for behavior-preserving refactors.

loop-test-e2e.description: Verify a complete user-visible journey through its real entry point, including success, invalid input and observable side effects. Use for end-to-end acceptance, not isolated units or one integration boundary.

loop-evaluate.description: Evaluate a skill or agent workflow using predefined cases, an explicit rubric and independently checked outcomes. Use for quality measurement, false-positive analysis and baseline comparison rather than code coverage.

loop-test-adversarial.description: Challenge a declared contract with isolated adversarial inputs and independently observed outcomes. Use to find false PASS results or boundary violations; use loop-security for a general threat review and loop-debug for an already identified bug.

loop-test-compatibility.description: Verify a declared compatibility matrix across versions, platforms, host adapters or data formats. Use to distinguish structural portability from executed behavior; use loop-test-integration for one boundary and loop-test-e2e for one complete journey.

loop-mcp-design.description: Design a scoped MCP client/server integration around a pinned protocol version, tool contracts and trust boundaries. Use before implementing or changing an MCP interface; use loop-mcp-test for execution and loop-mcp-security for defensive review.

loop-mcp-test.description: Exercise a versioned MCP interface using bounded local fixtures or an explicitly authorized server. Check tool contracts, correlation, error behavior and side effects; use loop-test-integration for non-MCP boundaries and loop-mcp-design for planning.

loop-mcp-security.description: Review an authorized MCP integration for tool trust, scoped authorization, credential handling and data-exfiltration boundaries. Use for MCP-specific defensive analysis; use loop-security for general code review and loop-test-adversarial for generic false-PASS challenges.

loop-deploy.description: Execute or rehearse a scoped deployment of a known release with health gates and rollback evidence. Use after release preparation when environment rollout is the goal; use loop-ci for pipeline repair and loop-migrate for persisted-data transformations.

loop-observe.description: Assess whether logs, metrics, traces and health signals can detect and explain an operational failure. Use for observability and alert verification; use loop-diagnose-performance for profiling and loop-deploy for executing a rollout.

loop-context.description: Prepare a compact, source-linked context packet for a specific task from existing artifacts. Use to select relevant constraints and resolve stale context before implementation; use loop-research to discover new sources.

loop-handoff.description: Create or validate a resumable checkpoint for unfinished agent work across sessions. Use to transfer current state, evidence and the next bounded action; use loop-orchestrate to launch follow-up processes.

loop-workflow-project.description: Turn an authorized small software project idea into an incremental delivery workflow with an MVP boundary, acceptance backlog, first verified slice and resumable state. Use for a new project lifecycle, not a single code change.

loop-workflow-pr.description: Prepare a reviewable pull-request delivery packet from a scoped branch or diff: establish the base, review changes, verify checks and write a truthful description. Create or update the remote PR only when authorized.

loop-workflow-incident.description: Coordinate an active service-incident assessment: establish impact, separate observations from hypotheses, choose authorized containment and verify recovery. Use for operational disruption, not an ordinary reproducible development bug.

loop-write.description: Draft or revise factual everyday emails, letters and short communications for a stated reader, preserving source facts, intent and unresolved commitments. Use for text drafting; use loop-document when file format and layout are part of acceptance.

loop-summarize.description: Condense supplied documents, notes or transcripts into a traceable summary while preserving material qualifiers, numbers, contradictions and source coverage. Use for faithful compression; use loop-research when new evidence must be discovered.

loop-meeting.description: Prepare an agenda or turn supplied meeting material into source-linked decisions, proposals, actions and unresolved questions. Use for meeting follow-through; not for inventing agreement, owners, completed tasks or calendar actions.

loop-organize.description: Choose the right organization workflow for existing files or personal work items. Use loop-files for filesystem mapping/moves and loop-work for priorities and deliverables; retain this entrypoint for mixed or older organize requests.

loop-decide.description: Compare everyday options against explicit constraints, evidence, priorities and uncertainty, then give a conditional choice or decision record. Use for choosing among options; use loop-evaluate for fixed-rubric grading and loop-table for data analysis.

loop-learn.description: Create a feasible learning plan or conduct a practice session using observable goals, retrieval, feedback and spaced review. Use for study/tutoring; do not claim mastery, grades or completed assessment from a generated plan.

loop-work.description: Complete a bounded everyday work package: turn a messy request into feasible priorities, produce the authorized deliverables, and leave a source-backed checkpoint. Use for multi-step office or personal projects, not a single draft or a software implementation plan.

loop-files.description: Organize selected local files through a pinned inventory, collision-safe mapping, authorized native moves and verified recovery. Use for filesystem organization; use loop-work for task priorities and loop-organize as a compatibility selector.

loop-table.description: Inspect, clean or analyze supplied tables with explicit types, units, missing-value rules and source-preserving output checks. Use when tabular data is the main input/output; not for guessing missing values or claiming spreadsheet recalculation from a saved file.

loop-document.description: Create or revise a usable document artifact with source-faithful content, requested file format and separate content/layout/export checks. Use for reports, briefs and formatted deliverables; use loop-write for text drafting alone and loop-docs for repository documentation maintenance.

loop.description: Find Loop skills by their canonical names or full need-based bundle selectors. Use as the Loop entry point for selection; it does not implement native slash aliases or automatically execute every bundle member.

loop-intake.description: Turn an ambiguous office or personal request into a source-backed brief with acceptance criteria, blockers and a bounded next action. Use before execution when the outcome is unclear; use loop-work to deliver an agreed package.

loop-support.description: Triage supplied support tickets into evidence-backed categories, impact, uncertainty and response drafts. Use for customer or internal help requests; do not invent SLAs, refunds, fixes or delivery.

loop-knowledge.description: Build or update a small source-linked knowledge set from multiple supplied documents, preserving conflicts, unknowns and revision identity. Use for reusable notes or FAQs; use loop-summarize for one source and loop-research to seek new evidence.

writing.purpose: Draft everyday communication and summarize supplied material

office.purpose: Complete everyday work packages with source-grounded drafts, records and document artifacts

learning.purpose: Plan study, understand supplied material and compare learning choices

decisions.purpose: Compare options with explicit priorities and source-grounded evidence

developer.purpose: Understand, implement or repair, test and review existing code

project.purpose: Coordinate a small software project and verified implementation slices

qa.purpose: Challenge contracts, assess evidence and inspect CI/review results

incident.purpose: Assess impact, investigate and verify operational signals

work.purpose: Coordinate feasible everyday deliverables and checkpoints

files.purpose: Inventory and verify scoped local file organization

documents.purpose: Draft, summarize and verify usable document files

data.purpose: Analyze tables and create source-grounded report artifacts

support.purpose: Scope incoming requests and triage source-backed support replies

knowledge.purpose: Build maintainable source-linked notes and FAQs
